summary_en: RECOMM to acquire 100% of Tomiya Co., Ltd. (Akita, office supplies and equipment distributor, founded 1797) via two-stage transaction: stock purchase for controlling stake (September 4, 2026) followed by simplified share exchange for remaining shares (September 7, 2026). Consideration partly in cash and partly in RECOMM shares (no new issuance; treasury shares used). Akita shareholder to retain ownership position post-closing.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of all shares in Tomiya Co., Ltd. (establishment of subsidiary) and complete acquisition via simplified share exchange
translation_en_brief: RECOMM Co., Ltd. announced on August 17, 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire all shares of Tomiya Co., Ltd., a Akita-based office supplies and equipment distributor founded in 1797, and make it a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction is structured in two stages: (1) a stock purchase to acquire controlling interest (planned for September 4, 2026), making Tomiya a consolidated subsidiary, and (2) a simplified share exchange to acquire remaining shares (effective September 7, 2026), achieving 100% ownership. The share exchange will proceed under Company Law Article 796(2) without RECOMM shareholder approval; RECOMM will use treasury shares to satisfy the stock consideration, issuing no new shares. The consideration comprises both cash and RECOMM ordinary shares. Tomiya's principal shareholder will retain an ownership stake in RECOMM post-closing. The acquisition is part of RECOMM's strategy to combine its IT solutions and business process outsourcing offerings with Tomiya's regional networks, customer base, and sales infrastructure in Akita. The filing does not disclose the yen amount of consideration or the number of RECOMM shares to be issued.
